About GB300 Descent

An independent side project that walks from the power grid down to a single silicon atom through a GB300 NVL72 data hall. It isn't an official CoreWeave or NVIDIA product.

What's real

Rack, tray, GPU and memory figures follow NVIDIA's published GB300 NVL72 specs, rounded. Physics and chip-scale sizes are textbook values.

What's typical

The grid, campus, building and hall levels are typical layouts, not any real site. Power, cooling and floor figures there are rounded industry-typical values, not data from a live facility.
